title: Niagara Walking Tour and Fireworks Cruise
includes: Niagara City Cruises fireworks cruise ticket
Assistance with boarding and souvenir poncho
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Chase Niagara’s after-dark magic without the hassle. Your guide leads a scenic, easy-paced walk through Oakes Garden Theatre and along the Niagara Parkway for front-row viewpoints of the illuminated Falls. Then you’ll head to the official Niagara City Cruises dock for Voyage to the Falls and the fireworks finale (weather dependent). Expect glowing skyline views, swirling mist, and plenty of photo moments of an unforgettable night.
